heading_text.description: Heading text to match against body_map.headings

new_text.description: Replacement heading text (for update) or new heading text (for add)

after.description: For action=add: heading text to insert after

md_heading.description: Markdown heading text in content.md for body paragraph extraction. Only needed when the heading text in content.md differs from heading_text (the template heading). If omitted, heading_text is used for lookup.

body_paragraphs.description: DEPRECATED. Body paragraph text content. Prefer passing content_md to compile_ops — the tool extracts body paragraphs from content.md deterministically. Only include if content_md is not available.
